target: रक्षाबंधन पर बहन भाई को राखी बाँधती है।
english: On Raksha Bandhan, a sister ties a rakhi on her brother.
reason: Textbook-stilted: "प्रणाम किया और उनका आशीर्वाद पाया" reads like a moral-education reader, and it restates the previous card almost word for word. Replaced with a real custom stated the way people actually state it.

target: इस संग्रहालय में यहाँ की लोक कलाओं का संग्रह है।
english: This museum has a collection of the local folk arts.
reason: Vacuous: "folk arts are very good" says nothing a learner would ever need to say. Replacement keeps the Sanskritized literary register of node-32 and is actually usable when travelling.

target: शाम को मोहल्ले के बच्चे गली में क्रिकेट खेलते हैं।
english: In the evening, the neighbourhood kids play cricket in the street.
reason: Pointless trivia: an encyclopedia line about kho-kho, not a culturally embedded expression anyone says. Replacement is real everyday Indian life on the same cultural node.

target: जन्मदिन पर हम मंदिर जाकर प्रसाद चढ़ाते हैं।
english: On birthdays we go to the temple and offer prasad.
reason: Niche and unnatural: a doll wedding is content no learner will use, and the object-fronted "शादी बच्चों ने रचाई" word order is contrived. Replacement is a common custom.

target: दादी सर्दी-ज़ुकाम में हल्दी वाला दूध पिलाती हैं।
english: Grandma gives us turmeric milk when we have a cold.
reason: Niche/archaic: हकीम and जड़ी-बूटी belong to a period drama, not to a learner's vocabulary. Replacement keeps the home-remedy cultural theme in words people use daily.

target: उन्होंने नौकरी छोड़ दी और अपना काम शुरू कर दिया।
english: He quit his job and started his own business.
reason: Officialese: "विधिवत रूप से पद छोड़ दिया" is bureaucratic filing language and duplicates hi-3163. Replacement keeps the node-35 compound-verb stacking (छोड़ दी / शुरू कर दिया) in ordinary speech.

target: सरकार ने नए नियम लागू कर दिए हैं।
english: The government has brought the new rules into effect.
reason: Vacuous fragment: "the government officially announced" with nothing announced. Replacement carries actual content and keeps the compound verb (कर दिए हैं).

target: बात इतनी बढ़ गई कि मुझे बीच में बोलना पड़ा।
english: Things got so out of hand that I had to step in.
reason: Vacuous abstraction: "this aspect is connected to both issues" is meeting-minutes filler with no situation behind it. Replacement gives node-35 the compound verbs and near-native feel it is meant to teach.

target: सर्दियों में सुबह जल्दी उठना मुश्किल हो जाता है।
english: In winter it becomes hard to get up early in the morning.
reason: Textbook trivia in literary vocabulary: "शिशिर ऋतु" and "पाला पड़ता है" are school-primer seasonal words, not speech. Replacement says something a person actually says about winter.

target: जल्दबाज़ी में मेरा पैर सीढ़ी पर फिसल गया।
english: In my hurry my foot slipped on the stairs.
reason: Pointless content: getting a foot stuck in a swamp is not a situation a learner will ever describe, and the sentence has no subject. Replacement keeps the same compound-verb pattern (फँस गया → फिसल गया) in a real scenario.

target: उसकी बात सुनकर मेरी आँखें खुल गईं।
english: Hearing what he said really opened my eyes.
reason: Pointless trivia and off-node: node-28 teaches Hindi idioms, but "Mars is called the Red Planet" contains none. Replacement uses आँखें खुलना, a core idiom.

target: काम इतना बढ़ गया कि मेरे हाथ-पाँव फूल गए।
english: There was so much work that I completely panicked.
reason: Textbook motto: "learning idioms adds colour to language" is the app talking about itself, not a sentence anyone says. Replacement actually uses an idiom (हाथ-पाँव फूलना) instead of praising them.

target: उसके दोस्त हमारे घर आकर डेरा डाल बैठे।
english: His friends came over and made themselves at home for good.
reason: Niche narrative content: bandits camping in a forest is storybook filler. Replacement keeps the same idiom (डेरा डालना) in the everyday sense people actually use it.

target: यह ख़बर सुनकर मेरे होश उड़ गए।
english: I was stunned when I heard this news.
reason: Decorative and off-node: a subjectless line about carving statues teaches no idiom, and node-28 is the idiom node. Replacement uses होश उड़ना.

target: चूँकि बारिश हो रही थी, इसलिए हमने बाहर जाना टाल दिया।
english: Since it was raining, we put off going out.
reason: Niche ritual content with no subject, and no advanced connector at all, which is what node-25 teaches. Replacement uses चूँकि…इसलिए in an ordinary situation.

target: इस रिपोर्ट से पता चलता है कि बच्चों की उपस्थिति बढ़ी है।
english: This report shows that children's attendance has gone up.
reason: Decorative poetry ("the child wanted to touch the sky") in the academic-Hindi node. Replacement supplies the formal argumentation pattern node-33 is for.

target: फ़ॉर्म पर हस्ताक्षर करके उसे जमा कर दीजिए।
english: Please sign the form and submit it.
reason: Legalese: "signatures were obtained on the power of attorney" is niche court paperwork. Replacement keeps the formal professional register but is something a learner will genuinely hear and say.
